scope: Enclosure-aware feature fidelity, one bounded alternate feature routing and local detail refinement, followed by independent editable export and browser QA. Source photographs, crop proposals and classified targets unchanged.

regular.timing: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

browser.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

limitations: Source-image agreement is not agreement with unavailable original cutting templates.
The fixed-crop half-resolution opening remains oversized and its outline has visible defects; the horizontal one-pixel crop shift still loses its opening.
Three complete photographs have no crop and remain failures.
Enclosure is a raster check for small substantial interior features, not a proof of exact continuous topology or identical source shapes.
No physical cutting or assembly test.
The improved actual browser upload still has visible frame defects and an oversized, angular opening. Passing the stated checks does not imply exact motif reconstruction.
